about.title: About the methodology
about.intro: SOAM (Systemic Occurrence Analysis Methodology) is EUROCONTROL's methodology for systemic analysis of safety occurrences. The application guides the investigator through the SOAM steps and uses the terms, codes and check questions from the Quick Reference Guide (QRG).
about.rights: QRG material © EUROCONTROL. Used with attribution, for non-commercial purposes, without altering the English wording.
about.step.register: Register the occurrence and assess severity (A–E)
about.step.shelo: Gather facts using the SHEL/O model
about.step.sort: Sort facts: contribution test and check questions
about.step.chart: SOAM Chart: barriers, human involvement, contextual conditions, organisational factors
about.step.actions: Safety actions (every barrier and every OSF addressed by at least one action; SMARTER)
about.translation: Russian translation is machine-made and needs review. Tajik is in progress.
